ruleset.name: nitpicker-code-smells
ruleset.description: Nitpicker code smell rules for main sources.

rule.name: RepeatedStringLiteral
rule.message: This string literal is repeated three times or more in the file. Name it once as a constant (private static final String NAME) and use the constant. If repeating it is intended, add an exception for pmd/RepeatedStringLiteral in nitpicker.config.json.
Remove the unused parameter, or use it. If it must stay (a framework callback), add an exception for pmd/UnusedFormalParameter in nitpicker.config.json.

rule.name: GenericTypeName
rule.message: Name this type for what it does (PriceRounder, OrderTotals), not Utils, Helper, Manager, Common or Misc. Pure logic shared between features goes in the shared package under such a name. If the name is intended, add an exception for pmd/GenericTypeName in nitpicker.config.json.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //*[self::ClassDeclaration or self::InterfaceDeclaration or self::EnumDeclaration or self::RecordDeclaration] [matches(@SimpleName, '^(Common|Misc|Miscellaneous)$|(Utils?|Utilities|Helpers?|Managers?)$')]

rule.name: GenericPackageName
rule.message: Name this package for what it holds, not utils, helpers, common or misc. Pure logic shared between features goes in the shared package under a name that says what it does. If the name is intended, add an exception for pmd/GenericPackageName in nitpicker.config.json.

rule.name: HardcodedSecret
rule.message: This variable holds a hardcoded secret. Read it from the environment or a secrets manager and inject it. If it is not a real secret, add an exception for pmd/HardcodedSecret in nitpicker.config.json.

rule.name: CredentialLiteral
rule.message: This string looks like a credential (access key, token or private key). Read it from the environment or a secrets manager. If it is not a real secret, add an exception for pmd/CredentialLiteral in nitpicker.config.json.

rule.name: SecretInLog
rule.message: A secret must not be logged. Log that it is set, or a masked tail, instead. If the value is not secret, add an exception for pmd/SecretInLog in nitpicker.config.json.

property.name: xpath
property.value: (//VariableAccess | //FieldAccess | //MethodCall) [matches(@Name, '(password|passwd|pwd|passphrase|secret|token|credentials?|api_?key|private_?key|access_?key|secret_?key|auth_?key|signing_?key|encryption_?key)$', 'i') or matches(@MethodName, '^get(Password|Secret|Token|ApiKey|PrivateKey|Credentials?)$')] [ancestor::MethodCall[1][@MethodName = ('trace', 'debug', 'info', 'warn', 'error', 'fatal', 'log', 'severe', 'warning', 'fine', 'finer', 'finest', 'println', 'print', 'printf')] [*[1][matches(@Name, '(^|\.)(log|logger|out|err)$', 'i') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.slf4j.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.logging.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.logging.log4j.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.io.PrintStream')]]]

rule.name: CatchOnlyLogsOrReturnsDefault
rule.message: This catch only logs the failure or returns a default, and carries on. Rethrow it with the cause (throw new FeatureException(message, e)) or return a failure result that carries the exception. If dropping it is intended, add an exception for pmd/CatchOnlyLogsOrReturnsDefault in nitpicker.config.json.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //CatchClause[Block[*]] [not(CatchParameter//ClassType[@SimpleName = 'InterruptedException'])] [not(Block/*[not( self::EmptyStatement or self::ContinueStatement or self::BreakStatement or self::ReturnStatement[not(*) or *[self::NullLiteral or self::BooleanLiteral or self::NumericLiteral or self::StringLiteral or self::CharLiteral] or *[self::MethodCall][@MethodName = ('emptyList', 'emptyMap', 'emptySet', 'empty', 'of')][not(ArgumentList/*)] or *[self::ConstructorCall][not(ArgumentList/*)]] or self::ExpressionStatement[MethodCall[@MethodName = ('trace', 'debug', 'info', 'warn', 'error', 'fatal', 'log', 'severe', 'warning', 'fine', 'finer', 'finest', 'println', 'print', 'printStackTrace')]] or self::ExpressionStatement[AssignmentExpression[*[2][self::NullLiteral or self::BooleanLiteral or self::NumericLiteral or self::StringLiteral or self::CharLiteral]]] )])]

rule.name: BooleanFlagParameter
rule.message: A boolean flag parameter makes the call site unreadable. Split the method into two methods named for each behavior, or pass an enum or a small record. If a boolean is the clearest form here, add an exception for pmd/BooleanFlagParameter in nitpicker.config.json.

property.name: xpath
property.value: (//MethodDeclaration | //ConstructorDeclaration)[@Visibility = 'public'] [not(ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName = 'Override'])] [not(self::MethodDeclaration[matches(@Name, '^set[A-Z]') and count(FormalParameters/FormalParameter) = 1])] [ancestor::*[self::ClassDeclaration or self::InterfaceDeclaration or self::EnumDeclaration][last()][@Visibility = 'public']] /FormalParameters/FormalParameter[not(ModifierList/Annotation)][PrimitiveType[@Kind = 'boolean'] or ClassType[@SimpleName = 'Boolean']]

rule.name: IoCallInLoop
rule.message: This calls a database, HTTP, file or repository API once per loop item (one query or request per item). Fetch or write all items at once (findAllById, WHERE id IN (...), one batched request, one file read). If a call per item is intended, add an exception for pmd/IoCallInLoop in nitpicker.config.json.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $bodies := ( //ForeachStatement/*[last()] | //ForStatement/*[last()] | //WhileStatement/*[last()] | //DoStatement/*[1] | //LambdaExpression[parent::ArgumentList/parent::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('forEach', 'forEachOrdered', 'map', 'flatMap', 'filter', 'peek', 'reduce', 'anyMatch', 'allMatch', 'noneMatch', 'mapToObj', 'mapToInt', 'mapToLong', 'collect')]]), $calls := $bodies//(MethodCall | ConstructorCall), $attempts := $bodies//TryStatement[Block[1]//(ReturnStatement | BreakStatement)]/Block[1]//(MethodCall | ConstructorCall) return ( ($calls except $attempts)[ self::ConstructorCall[ClassType[@SimpleName = ('FileReader', 'FileInputStream', 'FileWriter', 'FileOutputStream', 'RandomAccessFile')]] or self::MethodCall[*[1][@Name = 'Files' or descendant-or-self::*[@SimpleName = 'Files']]] or self::MethodCall[not(@MethodName = ('hashCode', 'toString', 'equals', 'getClass', 'close'))] [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.repository.Repository') or pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.EntityManager') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.EntityManager') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.sql.Statement') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.sql.Connection') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcOperations') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.client.RestOperations') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.client.RestClient') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.net.http.HttpClient')]] or self::MethodCall[matches(@MethodName, '^(find|load|read|query|select|insert|update|delete|exists|count|execute|fetch|list|write)|^(send|post|put|patch|exchange|retrieve|save)$')] [*[1][matches(@Name, '(repo|repository|dao|jdbc\w*|template|client|connection|conn|statement|stmt|entityManager|em|session|gateway|api)$', 'i')]] ][not(self::MethodCall[matches(@MethodName, '^(save|saveAndFlush|delete|deleteById|persist|merge|remove)$')] [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.repository.Repository') or pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.EntityManager')]])] | pmd-java:typeIs('java.sql.Statement') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.sql.Connection')]] [not(@MethodName = ('save', 'saveAndFlush', 'delete', 'deleteById', 'hashCode', 'toString', 'equals'))] )
